evidence.s1_ci: ci.yml runs `npm ci`, `npm test`, `npm run build` in site/ on pull_request (step1.patch 34-64). These are real scripts in site/package.json, and build includes svelte-check. Top-level permissions are `contents: read`. Pages: build job has contents: read, deploy job has `pages: write` and `id-token: write`. Only github.token is used, there is no pull_request_target, and nothing was pushed or run. But every action is referenced by mutable tag, not by full SHA: `actions/checkout@v4`, `actions/setup-node@v4`, `actions/upload-pages-artifact@v3`, `actions/deploy-pages@v4` (step1.patch 54-55, 93-94, 105, 121, 144-145). pages.yml also has `workflow_dispatch` and no `if: github.ref == 'refs/heads/main'` guard, so it can be dispatched from any branch (step1.patch 72-76).
evidence.s1_readme: README (step1.patch 330-413) covers requirements, Install (`npm ci`), Develop (`npm run dev`), Test (`npm test`), Build/preview, `PAGES_BASE`, and a table of the other scripts (index, fieldsets, prepare-data, sample-bullets). All of these exist in site/package.json. It also covers changelog and License (MIT, THIRD-PARTY.md, both present). Data contribution is only a pointer to CONTRIBUTING.md, where it is covered in detail. CONTRIBUTING's table still says `data/targets/<key>.json` while the text below says targets do not follow key naming (step1.patch 238, 245); target records have no `key` field.
evidence.s1_release: Version kept in site/package.json (0.1.0) and the lock file. Release made by `npm version X.Y.Z --no-git-tag-version`, changelog rename, `chore(release)` PR, then tag (CONTRIBUTING 283-318). release.yml checks the tag against package.json and against the CHANGELOG section, then runs test and build and creates a GitHub release with the changelog section as notes (step1.patch 151-190). CHANGELOG states Keep a Changelog 1.1.0 + SemVer and defines the bump rules. Dependabot covers npm (/site, grouped) and github-actions with a `chore(deps)` prefix, matching the stated convention. Conventional Commits is stated, and all 9 commits in commits.txt follow it.
evidence.s2_requirements: Route: `#/compare/<a>/<b>`, parsed from location.hash so it survives a reload (router.ts 34-42, href.compare). App.svelte lazy-loads Compare. SVG has role=img and aria-label `Profiles of {a} and {b}`, with two `<path>` elements (Compare.svelte). Outlines come from caseOuterProfile in one viewportFor viewport. Shot cartridges are excluded. Table: caption `Dimensions (mm|in)`; headers Symbol, A name, B name, Difference; FIELD_LABELS symbols; cartridge part only; FIELD_UNITS and `Tol` excluded; B−A. Units follow unitSystem(): formatValue for metric, displayNumber 'in' for imperial. Detail page has a Label `Compare with` + NativeSelect of other entries by name, and a `Compare` button that sets href.compare(key, chosen) (Cartridge.svelte 598-606). German strings were added for all keys (i18n.svelte.ts).
evidence.s2_correctness: dimensions() iterates GROUP_ORDER.cartridge and keeps typeof number fields that are not in FIELD_UNITS and do not end in Tol (compare.ts 160-172). Arrays (shotshell lists), angles and pressures are excluded. Metric values use formatValue (String, unrounded). Differences use displayNumber, which only strips float noise via toPrecision(12). Imperial divides by 25.4 via displayNumber. Head faces: both profiles start at z=0 and share one Viewport (common zMin/rMax, landscape), so x and the axis coincide. The test checks this. Shotshell returns null and shows a message. Unknown keys reject from load() into the catch branch. Weakness: a catch-all try/catch around the outlines hides any drawing bug, and the code's own comment calls it a 'shortcut'.
evidence.s2_fit: Reuses lib/core (FIELD_LABELS, FIELD_UNITS, GROUP_ORDER, orderedFields, formatValue), lib/geom (viewportFor, fullSectionPath), lib/shapes2d (adaptMetallic, caseOuterProfile), site units.ts displayNumber, units.svelte unitSystem, data.load/entries, PageHeader, Label, NativeSelect, ShadcnButton, $props.id (as in GlobalSettings), and the lazy chunk/router pattern. Minor issues: compare.ts 162 re-implements the group ordering of site/src/lib/fields.ts `orderedGroups`. The router docstring was changed to 'Six views', which is inaccurate. The `compare` class on the section has no style. The table is hand-styled with Tailwind rather than following GroupTable's numeric alignment, which is why step 3 was needed.
evidence.s2_tests: compare.test.ts tests the exclusions (units, Tol), the FIELD_LABELS symbol `e min`, unrounded metric values, B−A difference, imperial conversion, float-noise difference, head-face alignment and common axis of the outlines, and shotshell → null, all on real data via @lib/testing/fixtures. router.test.ts tests round-trip and malformed compare hashes. It uses the repo's vitest setup under site/src/lib. Gaps: no test of the caption, headers or accessible-name strings, or of the detail page select/button. The imperial test does not check row.b. The repo has no component test harness, so logic-level tests are consistent with it.
evidence.s3_fixes: compare.ts dimensionRows now takes the union of both key sets and writes '' for the missing value and for Difference (step3.patch 65-76). The new test asserts `delta L` has b='' and difference='', and `R3` has a='' and difference='', on the real 308_win/300_win_mag data, plus the ordering. Compare.svelte adds `text-right` to the three numeric `th` headers and their `td` cells; the Symbol column stays left. No unrelated changes. CHANGELOG entry amended. Split into a `fix:` commit and a `style:` commit. B-only symbols are appended after A's rows rather than in detail-page order; the comment did not ask for an order.
evidence.cross_step: Step 2 adds an Added entry under [Unreleased]. Step 3 amends that same unreleased entry, which fits Keep a Changelog for an unreleased feature. The version stays 0.1.0, consistent with the stated strategy of bumping only at release. Commits `feat:`, `fix:`, `style:` follow Conventional Commits. `style:` is used for a user-visible alignment change, which Angular-style conventions reserve for formatting, but CONTRIBUTING does not define the types. Imports and types look consistent with svelte-check and vitest; tests were not run here.

strengths: Thorough and consistent release setup: version in site/package.json, a tag-triggered release that checks the tag against the version and changelog, Keep a Changelog + SemVer rules, Dependabot with a matching commit prefix, and every commit following Conventional Commits.
The compare feature meets every requirement of step 2 as written, with real reuse of lib/core, lib/geom, lib/shapes2d, units.ts and the site's UI components, and with German strings.

The step 3 fixes are exact and minimal: a union of dimensions with empty cells, right-aligned numeric columns and headers, tests on the real 308 Win./300 Win. Mag. data for `delta L` and `R3`, and an updated changelog.
issues: Every GitHub Action is referenced by mutable tag (actions/checkout@v4, setup-node@v4, upload-pages-artifact@v3, deploy-pages@v4) instead of a full commit SHA, in ci.yml, pages.yml and release.yml.
pages.yml allows `workflow_dispatch` with no guard on github.ref, so a deploy can be dispatched from any branch, not only main.

Minor fit and robustness issues in step 2: compare.ts re-implements orderedGroups' group ordering, a catch-all try/catch the code itself calls a 'shortcut' hides drawing bugs, and the table did not copy the detail page's right alignment until step 3.
review.verdict: The work is solid: the CI, release and changelog strategy is coherent and followed across all steps, and the compare view meets every requirement with good reuse of the existing libraries and focused tests. Its main defect is supply-chain hygiene in the workflows (actions not pinned to SHAs, and a Pages workflow_dispatch with no branch guard), which should be fixed before merging.
